verdict.rationale: Codegen documents that agents present a structured implementation plan before executing (codegen-docs-22) and offers permission settings like requiring signed commits (codegen-docs-25), suggesting some scope visibility and control, but there is no explicit documented gate requiring an engineering-lead's sign-off on the plan/contract before the agent is allowed to touch the repository. Missing for 10: explicit approval workflow/UI blocking agent execution until a lead approves, audit trail of approval decisions, and evidence of enforcement (not just plan presentation).
